global_layer.context: A single continuous aerial take following a car along a winding coastal cliff road.
global_layer.description: A red vintage convertible drives along a serpentine road carved into green cliffs above a turquoise sea; the drone follows and rises.

aesthetics.color_scheme: turquoise sea, white surf, green cliffs, a red car

audio_baseline.ambience: high wind and the distant hum of the car engine, waves crashing far below

objects_static.position: on the road in the center

lighting_baseline.shadows: crisp shadows of the cliffs on the water
lighting_baseline.source_consistency: the lighting holds steady for the full clip

environment_baseline.background_setting: a rugged coastline with steep green cliffs, a winding road, and a deep blue sea

segment_basic_info.segment_description: The drone follows behind the car as it rounds a hairpin bend above the sea.
segment_basic_info.active_background: waves break white against the rocks

camera_delta.camera_position: thirty meters above and behind the car
camera_delta.composition: wide, car in the center third

dynamic_state.state_change: the car takes a hairpin turn
dynamic_state.motion_detail: it leans slightly into the bend

special_audio_events.sound_description: a smooth engine hum rising and falling with the turn

segment_basic_info.segment_description: The drone rises and tilts down to reveal the whole coastline as the car continues on.
segment_basic_info.active_background: the road winds into the distance

camera_delta.composition: very wide, car tiny on the road

dynamic_state.motion_detail: it shrinks as the camera rises

special_audio_events.sound_description: the engine fades under rising wind
